LanguageData.LP_HaloOfLight.label: circlet of holy light
LanguageData.LP_HaloOfLight.description: The highest honor of the league's paladins: a pale golden halo hanging over the head. Any attack (including melee) has a 20% chance to be blocked completely by the halo, at most 5 blocks per day. Worn on the head in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_PuritySeal.label: purifying seal
LanguageData.LP_PuritySeal.description: A parchment strip with a holy symbol wax seal. "Applied", it's sealed onto clothing worn by the user, taking no slot, up to 3: each gives mental break threshold -3%; once per day automatically breaks free of domination or fear. Requires torso clothing to apply; stripping naked won't make the seals fall off (they seal the person).
LanguageData.LP_PsychicHood.label: psionic hood
LanguageData.LP_PsychicHood.description: A dark hood studded with psionic lattice. When allies within 5 cells of the wearer (including themself) are targeted by enemy psychic or psionic abilities (domination, mind reading, psychic jolts, psycasts from psionic expansions, etc.), there's a 40% chance the spell misses. A specific counter to mind flayers. Worn on the head in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_CogOfMakers.label: tinker god's gear
LanguageData.LP_CogOfMakers.description: The holy symbol of the dwarven heretical "god of gears", a copper gear that never stops turning. Mechanoid repair and maintenance speed ×1.5; the wearer's bionic parts aren't shut down by EMP (not stunned by EMP). Worn on the chest in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_InquisitorSeal.label: inquisitor's badge
LanguageData.LP_InquisitorSeal.description: The rose badge of a league inquisitor. Negotiation ability ×1.2 (easier recruiting and interrogation); while someone in the colony wears it, goodwill gains with Faerûn's pioneer league ×1.25; witch-hunting zealots won't raid this colony. At league goodwill ≥75, the Harpers send a badge as a gift (only once). Worn on the chest in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_RevivalCore.label: revival core
LanguageData.LP_RevivalCore.description: A dark green crystal core set inside the breastplate, with an ancient revival protocol still running. When the wearer dies, there's a 50% chance after 24 hours to revive in a weakened state, and the core shatters (success or not). Doesn't stack with troll revival or the death knight set (the core won't activate then). Worn on the chest in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_MarkBlood.label: mark of blood
LanguageData.LP_MarkBlood.description: An iron plate branded with a blood-red eight-pointed star that grows into the flesh when pressed to the chest. Melee damage +30%, pain shock threshold +20%; but after 3 days without fighting, an ever-worsening "bloodthirst" mood sets in. Cursed item: can't be removed once worn. No cost when worn by a lich (league goodwill -30, deducted only once).
LanguageData.LP_MarkBlood.comps.CompCursed.disguiseDe: An old dark red amulet, faintly warm to the touch. The Black Network says it "makes you hit harder".
LanguageData.LP_MarkDecay.label: mark of decay
LanguageData.LP_MarkDecay.description: A triple-ring mark grown with verdigris. Immune to disease and toxic buildup, bleeding rate -50%; but the wearer's beauty -3, and people within 5 cells get mood -2. Cursed item: can't be removed once worn. No cost when worn by a lich (league goodwill -30, deducted only once).
LanguageData.LP_MarkDecay.comps.CompCursed.disguiseDe: An old amulet covered in verdigris. The Black Network says it "makes you immune to every illness".
LanguageData.LP_MarkChange.label: mark of change
LanguageData.LP_MarkChange.description: A blue mark whose color keeps shifting. Psychic sensitivity +40%, research speed +20%; but one small oddity happens each day (a brief stun, or two skills' passions swap). Cursed item: can't be removed once worn. No cost when worn by a lich (league goodwill -30, deducted only once).
LanguageData.LP_MarkChange.comps.CompCursed.disguiseD: An old amulet of an indescribable color. The Black Network says it "opens your mind".
LanguageData.LP_MarkRapture.label: mark of pleasure
LanguageData.LP_MarkRapture.description: A purple-pink serpentine mark. Move speed +15%, recreation need falls 50% slower; but mood is capped at 90%. Cursed item: can't be removed once worn. No cost when worn by a lich (league goodwill -30, deducted only once).
LanguageData.LP_MarkRapture.comps.CompCursed.disguise: An old amulet with a purple glow. The Black Network says it "lightens you up".
